description: Diamond path with four sharp corners, started from a pose deviating from the reference vertex - the paper's non-zero-initial-condition test ('the robot initiates motion from a point deviating from the reference vertex'). x_ref = a*sgn(cos t)*(1-|sin t|), y_ref = a*sgn(sin t)*(1-|cos t|), a = 1.0 m. Paper Table 2: ISE 1.2032, IAE 3.8314, ITAE 35.6702, final error 0.0405 m, mean torque 9.237 N.m, Ks_final 4.568.
